title: Koodikazhcha
overview: Koodikazhca is a 1991 Indian Malayalam film, directed by T. S. Suresh Babu and produced by Thomi Kunju. The film stars Jayaram, Urvashi, Jagadish and Usha in lead roles. The film had musical score by S. P. Venkatesh.
